findings.description: Direct inspection of the fresh V87 sit and crouch renders shows substantial thigh exposure. The matching-pose surface-ray audit measures shorts coverage at sit L/R 13.11%/13.11% and crouch L/R 16.72%/16.72%. Overskirt coverage remains sit 18.64%/18.53% and crouch 32.77%/32.88%. These readings do not establish fit or usable coverage.

Direct inspection of the V87 neutral, sit, and crouch renders shows the under-shorts do not form a continuous, leg-following covering surface in the posed images; exposed upper thighs remain prominent and the gusset/hem is not visually validated for use.

Direct inspection of front, back, left, right, and three-quarter views shows pronounced accordion-like side corrugation and projecting, irregular hem corners. The fabric silhouette reads as a prototype with uneven drape.

The actual V87 Blender build report records passed=false and REJECT: avatar fit, deformation weights, and zero-unweighted-vertex checks fail. The rendered appearance does not override those geometry gates; UV, shape-key, Unity, and VRChat behavior remain unverified.

nextAction: Keep V87 rejected. Rework the shorts coverage and continuous gusset to improve pose-matched thigh coverage, correct the measured leg-surface mapping, and assign real bone weights to the newly added gusset and shorts vertices. Rework overskirt section geometry to reduce side corrugation and projecting hem corners. Then rerun from the changed canonical pattern stage, rebuild, and inspect new renders and geometry evidence. Do not publish or release this prototype.
